purpose: Teach: プロット/譜面/増刊/アセスメント/書き下ろし/個人向け/抵当/約定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文のプロット構成を見直せ
lines.en: Ren, take another look at the structure of your paper's argument.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Clear expectation in the tone. Leans forward slightly. Brief pause before the instruction—gives weight to what follows.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新作の譜面を学会で発表します
lines.en: Yes. I'm presenting the new composition at the conference.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. A touch eager underneath—wants to show he's understood and is already moving. Slight uptick in energy at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学術誌の増刊号にも投稿しろ
lines.en: And submit to the journal's special issue as well.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. 'And' lands with quiet insistence—this is not optional. Eyes steady. No warmth, no harshness. Just expectation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験のリスクアセスメントを徹底します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the risk assessment for the experiments is thorough.
lines.style: Careful, methodical delivery. Each phrase gets its own weight—he's thinking as he speaks. Slight tension at the shoulders, wanting to get it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、書き下ろし論文の機会を逃すな
lines.en: Don't let this chance to write an original paper slip away from you.
lines.style: Sharper edge now. The word 'don't' has a light tap of warning. Slower pace. This is advice wrapped as instruction—something he cares about Ren hearing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。個人向けの研究紹介サイトも準備中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm also preparing a research introduction website for independent distribution.
lines.style: Quicker than before—he's energised now, showing initiative. Pride just barely audible underneath. Still respectful, but warmer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、留学費用の抵当に困らないよう奨学金を活用しろ
lines.en: Make use of scholarships so you're not burdened by the costs of studying abroad.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. This is practical care disguised as direction. A pause before 'studying abroad'—the real weight of it. Almost paternal, but still composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究の約定書を学会で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I've already handled the agreement terms for the joint research project at the conference.
lines.style: Quieter than his previous responses. A sense of completion, of having already taken action. The word 'already' carries relief. Trailing off gently—the work is done.
